subject: general
question: In a class consisting of 67 students, Teena ranked 12th from the top and her friend Rishabh ranked 26th from the bottom. How many students ranked between Teena and Rishabh?
solution:
Given:

 
• In a class consisting of 67 students.
 
• Teena ranked 12th from the top and her friend Rishabh ranked 26th from the bottom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f32ccc99265b0139e3339471fcd0b77ace2f6d06918c63a88069c624c520a2b.png] 

**Rishabh rank from the top:**

=> Total students = Rishabh rank from top + Rishabh rank from the bottom - 1

=> 67 = Rishabh rank from top + 26 - 1

=> Rishabh rank from top = 67 - 25 = 42

**Students ranked between Teena and Rishabh:**

=> Students ranked between Teena and Rishabh = Rishabh rank from top - Teena rank from top - 1

=> Students ranked between Teena and Rishabh = 42 - 12 - 1 = 42 - 13 = 29

Hence, **"29"** Students ranked between Teena and Rishabh.
